notes: Godot 4.5 Forward+ playable Koi-Koi (hanafuda) card game with main menu, scoring/yaku, win/lose, and MCTS AI opponent. SPDX GPL-3.0 (LICENSE). Card artwork under art/ is a derivative of Louie Mantia, CC BY-SA 4.0 (art/README.md and README.md). Fonts Sour Gummy and Zen Maru Gothic are SIL OFL 1.1 (Google Fonts / name-table license). App icon is custom src/assets/icon.png (md5 6d6454342ef15b6b33a6878f23f954cf); a leftover default Godot icon.svg remains in assets/ but is not config/icon. Omitted unused GUT unit-test git submodule (SSH url, empty in a shallow clone; not required to play) plus .github/. No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no keystore.
